title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.87
exact_target: If a finite group has d-generator subgroups with relatively prime indices collectively, must the whole group have at most d+1 generators?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2596 (KOU-21.87). CC BY 4.0.

A. Lucchini, Problem 21.87, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
